$comment: Known high/critical npm advisories that are deliberately left in the tree, and why (#337). Read by scripts/ci/npm-audit-gate.mjs. Every entry needs a reason and dev_only (true holds only while `npm audit --omit=dev` does not report the same advisory); an entry that stops matching fails CI so it is removed. Never add one to make CI green without saying what would have to change for it to be fixed.
